protocol: CTO001 clean population synthetic diagnostic v1
draw_order: For each M: row probabilities shape (N,4); initial pair integers in [0,4); then M consecutive random(N) transition arrays.
prior: four independent Uniform[0,1) row probabilities and independent uniform initial pair; float64 implementation of continuous uniform prior
batch_partition: consecutive trajectory indices, fixed before simulation
MC_SE: sample standard deviation of 100 batch means (ddof=1) divided by sqrt(100)
interval: mean +/- 1.96 estimated MC SE, approximate, pointwise, not a theorem or simultaneous interval
observed_transitions: exactly M; no prediction label drawn
gate: d=1-first(terminal pair); accept iff J>0 and 512D>=J; designated C/J if accepted else 0; convert to probability of 1
no_A_logloss: A may equal 0 or 1 while B is strictly interior; its population logloss can be infinite. No epsilon clipping.
